retrieval_plan.anchor_strategy: Find one public infrastructure/software or IT project with published baseline plan, monthly progress reports, and cost tracking data in the same currency and reporting period. Use its progress and financial reports to populate schedule, cost, and quality nodes.
coherence_requirements: All external_input nodes must come from the same project, same reporting period, same currency, and same units for budget vs. actual costs.
Milestone dates in planned and actual records must use the same baseline version for variance calculation.
Standards and acceptance criteria in quality records must match those named in the approved plan.
Derived nodes i5, i6, i7 must reference the same project entity and reporting period as the external inputs.
Professional judgment in i8 should rely only on the retrieved data, not general occupational guidance.

expected_gaps.reason: Quality/standards evidence (tests, reviews, acceptance results) is often private or not published with cost and schedule records, leaving the conformance node partially empty.
Detailed activity-level actual dates may be redacted or aggregated in public reports, limiting precise milestone variance analysis.

refinement.reason: The inspected LAO file on the California State Payroll System (CSPS) IT project is the anchor. The information nodes i1 (approved plan/milestones/cost targets) and i2/i3 (progress and cost records) remain missing. The file supplies partial planning context (approved baseline ~$1.2B, ~6-year schedule, Sept 2031 completion, $88.3M spent of $128.7M by Jan 2025, DART methodology). A focused search should retrieve authoritative project status/baseline milestone and cost-target documents within the same project and state jurisdiction before concluding the case cannot be supported.

rejected.reason: Program-level funding report covering multiple projects rather than one jurisdiction/organization/project case; also a completed analysis/recommendation artifact that risks leaking the work the solver must do.
General policy/instructions (SIMM 45 Appendix F) describing how to report, not an actual project's status under deadline, standard, and cost monitoring.
UK HMRC portfolio data would combine an unrelated jurisdiction with the California anchor and is portfolio-level rather than a single project case.

selected.reason: California LAO report on the State Payroll System IT project — a single jurisdiction/organization case (State of California) matching the anchor, providing authoritative project-level schedule, scope, and cost performance data for a real software project. Rejected c_09b29724a90aa5ab69d251b9 (policy/instructions, not project results) and c_6d2b5ab83ed49f714d636066 (program-level funding report, not a single project case), and c_ebbf65d1270c50ad9b1a7471 to avoid mixing UK data with the California case.
